fieldguide.entity.apple_cows.apple_cow.d: Cows that bear beautiful red fruit! They have soft multilayered fluff to grow apples and are just as sweet as you'd expect!
fieldguide.entity.apple_cows.enchanted_g: In the Aether, legends speak of a fleeting moo so soothing and enchanting, that no sound could ever rival it...
fieldguide.entity.apple_cows.golden_appl: Apple cows infused with the aether's essence, turning them gold!
